Chromaprint 1.6.2 by Lukas Lalinsky and contributors
https://github.com/acoustid/chromaprint/releases/tag/v1.6.2

Distributed as a shared library. Upstream treats the complete release as
LGPL 2.1. See LICENSE.md in the included source archive and COPYING.LGPLv2.1
in the media helper distribution. The build uses KissFFT (BSD 3-Clause),
whose license and copyright notices are in src/3rdparty/kissfft in the archive.

CMake builds the unmodified release and uses the KissFFT implementation.
The media helper supplies mono PCM at 11025 Hz. The library can be rebuilt
from the archive and replaced with a compatible library in a custom package.
